messages:
Priya: Quick sync 1: were planning a coordinated announce with GateFlow (gateway), NorthStar SI, and NimbleCompute (HW partner) plus adapters for LangChain & LlamaIndex. Target release week: May 12-16. Who volunteers to keep the checklist and timeline?
Sam: I can run the dry-run greenroom and manage demo readiness. Need final end-to-end script by Thu.
Lena: Legal note 1: partners must return signed asset permissions and quote approvals by Fri COB. Also need a short legal-approved blurb for the press release.
Jordan: Marketplace ops check 1: AWS prefers May 13; GCP slot looks like May 15. If we want simultaneous listing we need the AMI/Helm links and billing SKU matrix ready two business days prior.
Mei: I'll own partner coordination and confirm NorthStars case study content. Ping me any suggested customer quote lines.
Alex: Technical ask 1: are adapters pinned to specific model versions? LangChain adapter v0.8 works fine; LlamaIndex v0.5 had a schema change. We should note recommended adapter versions in the announcement to reduce confusion.
Priya: Good idea. Add a compatibility table to the press assets. Also, include our fallback routing behavior so customers know we have reliability safeguards.
Sam: Greenroom checklist items I need: stable demo dataset, reproducible deploy command, smoke tests (latency/cost), partner contact on call. Can someone paste the staged deploy command?
Alex: Demo deploy snippet:
```bash
./deploy_demo.sh --env=greenroom --model=redwood-llama-7b-q4 --adapter=gateflow-1.3 --cache=true
# run smoke
curl -s -X POST https://greenroom.staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"Summarize Q1 results"}'
```
Use a partner-scoped API key for the greenroom.
Lena: Also send me a data flow diagram showing token routing and KV cache boundaries 1: must show no customer data persists on partner infrastructure.
Jordan: On SKUs: I'll draft a matrix mapping hosted vs dedicated SKUs, marketplace identifiers, and billing contact fields. Expect upload by Wed midday.
Mei: NimbleCompute asked for a short approval turnaround on their logo and partner blurb. Ill chase them and loop legal if delayed.
Sam: Suggest we highlight the orchestration story: GateFlow handles adapter routing, NorthStar handles integration services, NimbleCompute provides optimized inferencing profiles. Short bullets for PR would help.
Priya: Yes 1: talking points = 1) unified orchestration across Hosted/Dedicated, 2) SI enablement (NorthStar playbook), 3) HW acceleration partner (NimbleCompute perf gains), 4) compatibility with LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters.
Alex: Canary plan: run 200 short queries across Hosted + Dedicated with adapter permutations, measure 95th p99 latency and error rates. If errors >1% or p95 >300ms for 5m, trigger rollback to safe model. I can run this Thu morning.
Sam: We'll include that rollback policy in the ops FAQ. Also propose we publish a short technical note about how the gateway adapter handles KV prefixes to avoid LlamaIndex regressions.
Lena: Confirming embargo: May 12 10:00 PT. Partners and Redwood must acknowledge. I'll file the legal checklist and send confirmations.
announce-bot: Reminder set 1: Greenroom dry-run 2025-05-11 09:00 PT; Announcement 2025-05-12 10:00 PT. Reaction: :loud_sound:
Priya: Owners roundup 1: Greenroom = Sam; Legal/assets = Lena; Marketplace/SKUs = Jordan; Partner comms = Mei; Tech tests = Alex. I'll create a confluence page and calendar invites. Post any blockers here.
Jordan: Uploading initial SKU matrix now.
Alex: Canary logs will be posted to the checklist link after run.
Sam: Demo script draft pushed to branch gateflow-pub. Will update when regression completes.
Lena: Following up with partner legal for logo + blurb signoff.
Mei: NorthStar confirmed quote lines; will route for approval.
Priya: Thanks everyone 1: keep updates in-thread. Closing unless blockers arise. :white_check_mark:
